companyconcept_substitutions.us-gaap:Revenues: The companyconcept endpoint serves this element with empty units for this filer, so the rows come from the issuer's XBRL fact set in the companyfacts payload instead.

capture_policy.context_policy: The SEC facts APIs publish facts without dimensional qualifiers, so every row in this capture is a fact with no dimensions. They do not publish the filing's contextRef, so each row's context is pinned by (accession, element, period, unit) with no dimensions, which identifies exactly one fact in that filing.
capture_policy.dimensions: The SEC facts payloads publish only facts with no dimensional qualifiers, so every row here is a consolidated fact and the capture carries no segment or member variants.

source.note: The SEC facts APIs publish facts without dimensional qualifiers, so every row in this capture is a fact with no dimensions. They do not publish the filing's contextRef, so each row's context is pinned by (accession, element, period, unit) with no dimensions, which identifies exactly one fact in that filing.
source.retrieval: one request for the issuer's XBRL fact set; the rows of each element are taken verbatim and re-keyed to the companyconcept shape the production loaders read

source.note: The acceptance datetime decides when a filing's facts first become knowable, which is the point-in-time rule the lane applies.
source.retrieval: one request per periodic filing for the filing's SGML header; the acceptance datetime is read from the header's ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME field, which is America/New_York local time
